messages:
Aisha Patel: Heads up — we got a customer report that after they upgraded python-sdk to 0.18.2 their requests are getting assigned to the default routing policy instead of tenant-specific route. Console shows no observed route for their API key.
Ben Chu: Interesting — did they opt into telemetry consent header? We added automatic telemetry-consent header in 0.18.x for route-tagging.
Carla Romero: If SDK doesn't send routehint, the platform should fall back to header-less routing. What's the exact header name?
Aisha Patel: `X-RW-Telemetry-Consent: route_hint` — saw in their telemetry logs that SDK is sending `xrw-telemetry` lowercased and the proxy normalization is dropping it
Ben Chu: ugh casing again. Our proxy canonicalizes header names but we added a whitelist only for dashed headers. small snippet from access logs:
```
'headers': {'xrw-telemetry':'{"route":"tenant-42"}'}
```
proxy->route-resolver: header not matched -> default-route
Samir Khan: Can reproduce locally with py 0.18.2. It lowercases and strips the dash in our serialization path. Looks like python-sdk's requests lib is building headers wrong during batch send.
Carla Romero: Is this a breaking change? We need a short-term fallback on platform: accept either `xrw-telemetry`, `x-rw-telemetry`, and `x_rw_telemetry` variants for next week.
Aisha Patel: Agreed. Console mapping expects canonical `X-RW-Telemetry`. UX issue: dashboard route attribution shows as 'unattributed' which will trigger alerts.
Ben Chu: Plan: platform shim to accept variants (owner: Ben, ETA: tomorrow). SDK patch to restore canonical header (owner: Samir, ETA: next patch). We'll roll the shim behind a feature flag + gradual rollout to prod regions.
Samir Khan: Working on SDK fix now. Quick patch: replace header key generation with `normalize_header('X-RW-Telemetry')` and add unit test.
Carla Romero: Also adding telemetry consent opt-out bool to Console docs so customers can see impact on routing attribution.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Flipping canary flag for shim in us-west-2 (canary=on)
Aisha Patel: Thanks. After shim is live, can we run a dashboard query: `route_attribution:unattributed | count by api_key` and DM me results? I want to confirm customers fixed.
Ben Chu: :thumbsup: I'll post the query results in #eng-platform-stats tomorrow morning.
Samir Khan: FYI I'll push 0.18.3 with the header fix + add migration note in changelog.
Carla Romero: :eyes: also file a follow-up to remove shim in 2 weeks once we see stable adoption.
